title: Occurrence
description: One instance of an AppOmni Posture Finding against one object in one monitored service. Derived from AppOmni's public Postman collection at https://api.appomni.com/.

fields.name: identity_hash
fields.description: Stable hash of the occurrence identity

fields.name: monitored_service_id
fields.description: Monitored service this occurrence was found in

fields.name: detailed_status_name
fields.description: Machine name of the detailed status

fields.name: detailed_status_label
fields.description: Display label of the detailed status

fields.name: context
fields.description: Subject detail; keys vary by finding type

fields.name: last_closed
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, null while open
